name: pager
title: Pager
summary: Previous, a position such as “2 of 5”, and next, for stepping through a short set.
description: Previous, a position ("2 of 3", optionally with rolling digits) and next, for stepping through a short set: insights, questions, results. The buttons are ghost square buttons that stop at the ends unless the pager loops; arrow keys, Home and End page while focus is inside; the position is announced through a status region. Mirrored right-to-left.

anatomy.description: The real Button (ghost, sm, square, muted), marked data-pager="prev"; aria-label; aria-disabled="true" at the first page unless it loops (stays focusable) With our tooltip, its aria-label (the adapters wrap it in Tooltip).
role=status. Plain: the text "2 of 3" (plus a visually hidden unit). Rolling: visually hidden text, digits and total (aria-hidden).
Without reel, when spokenSeparator differs from separator: the visible position ("2 / 3"), aria-hidden; a visually hidden span beside it says "2 of 3".
One 1em window per digit of the page number
The column 0–9 inside a digit; the recipe's digit variant is its value; carries kbd-instant
The real Button (ghost, sm, square, muted), marked data-pager="next"; aria-disabled="true" at the last page unless it loops With our tooltip, its aria-label (the adapters wrap it in Tooltip).

page.description: Current page, 0-based. React: page / defaultPage / onPageChange; Vue: v-model:page; Svelte: bind:page.

count.description: Number of pages. With 0 or 1 both buttons are disabled.

loop.description: Wrap around at the ends; the buttons never disable.

reel.description: Roll each digit of the position like a counter (approval-card).

layout.description: between: prev · position · next. start: position · prev · next (the DOM order stays prev · position · next).

orientation.description: horizontal: left and right carets, mirrored right-to-left. vertical: up and down carets for content that slides vertically; Up and Down page too.

separator.description: Between page and count: "of" (2 of 3) or "/" (2 / 3).

spokenSeparator.description: What screen readers hear between page and count, whatever the visible separator ("2 / 3" is read "2 of 3").

unit.description: Read before the position by screen readers only: "Question" → "Question 2 of 3".

prevProps.description: Attributes for the previous button, so a host can tie it to what it pages (carousel: aria-controls="<its slide group>"). The pager's own aria-label and aria-disabled win.

nextProps.description: Attributes for the next button, as prevProps.

keyboard: Tab reaches the previous and the next button (a disabled end stays focusable through aria-disabled)
Enter / Space on a button page once; nothing happens on a disabled end
ArrowLeft / ArrowRight page back and forward while focus is inside (swapped right-to-left)
ArrowUp / ArrowDown page back and forward too when the pager is vertical
Home / End jump to the first and the last page
Focus stays on the button that was used, also when it becomes disabled
notes: Give the group a label that names what is paged ("Choose insight").
The position is a status region: every change is announced ("Question 2 of 3" with a unit).

motion: reel: a digit rolls to its value over duration.move easing.out-strong: the outgoing figure leaves and the incoming one arrives (transform and opacity); the current figure rests untransformed, so it lines up with the text beside it at every display scale; instant from the keyboard (kbd-instant)
buttons: the button's own press scale and hover
notes: Composition: the host owns what is paged (the pages, the sliding track) and listens for the page change.
